definitions.explanation: Describes something extremely rare or unusual in occurrence. Carries a formal, literary tone and is often used to emphasize just how exceptional something is.

examples.japanese: {稀有|けう}な⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{稀有|けう}なことだ。
examples.english: An experience like this is truly rare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{稀有|けう}な⟦{自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}→自然環境：22932_shizenkankyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残|のこ}されている→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: A natural environment rare even by world standards remains on this island.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a na-adjective ({稀有|けう}な). This is a formal, literary word — in everyday conversation, ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧ is far more common. {稀有|けう} is chosen when the speaker wants to emphasize how truly exceptional something is.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {稀有|けう}な⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: rare talent
- {稀有|けう}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: a rare existence
- {稀有|けう}な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧: a rare case
- {稀有|けう}な⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: a rare experience

PRONUNCIATION:
Also sometimes read きゆう, but けう is the standard modern reading.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧ is the everyday word for "rare" or "unusual." {稀有|けう} is more elevated and emphasizes extraordinary rarity. ⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧ means "scarce" and is used more for resources, species, and quantities.
